about_the_game:
The Mysterious Mansion puts the player in the shoes of an investigator investigating a mysterious disappearance. Following clues from an email, you find yourself in a mansion known for its dark past. However, the moment you step inside, the doors are locked, the lights are forced to go out, and you are to confront beings from another world.

Dark, demon-like creatures, the restless spirit of the lost girl, and the gloomy atmosphere of a rainy night… All of this will gradually draw you into paranoia and fear.

To escape, you must collect items, solve puzzles, and uncover mysteries. But this isn't just limited to the mansion. As you walk through the forest, you'll encounter zombies and fight for survival to reach your second home. Your only chance to escape is to piece together all the clues and survive that cursed night.

🎮 Features:

Suspenseful Story: Track a missing girl and uncover dark truths.

Atmospheric Locations: Various levels set in an office, gas station, mansion, forest, and second home.

Survival Experience: Collect items, solve puzzles, and battle zombies.

Supernatural Threats: Confront demon-like entities and restless spirits.

  • Graphics: GTX 1060 and up

  • Storage: 10000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Stereo. Play with good stereo.
